content:
“You've tapped the Wasteland's hidden wealth.”— Perk card description

**Cap Collector** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

A chance to increase amount of caps found based on Luck. The chance is also based on Luck.

| Luck | Trigger Chance | 
| 1 ≤ LCK < 15 | 20% | 
| 15 ≤ LCK < 30 | 40% | 
| 30 ≤ LCK < 60 | 60% | 
| 60 ≤ LCK ≤ 100 | 85% | 

| ![FO76 cap collector perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/f/fd/FO76_cap_collector_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Luck | Ammo Multiplier | 
| | 1 | 1.05 | 
| | 15 | 1.75 | 
| | 30 | 2.2 | 
| | 60 | 2.65 | 
| | 100 | 3 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You find more bottle caps based on your LCK. | 0004C942 | 

- The perk can trigger on any container in the game, this includes enemy corpses.
- Before update 58, the perk had 3 ranks that provided 33%/66%/100% more caps from caps stashes.
- Before update 5, caps stashes were items and the perk applied to them automatically at pickup.
